account.change_password_hint: Changing your password signs out every other device.
account.description: Sign-in details for the site. Your in-game character is separate.
account.title: Your account
admin.action.ban_confirm: They will not be able to join until someone unbans them.
admin.action.kick_confirm: They will be disconnected. They can rejoin unless you also ban them.
admin.action.lift_confirm: They will be able to join again immediately.
admin.action.restart_confirm: Everyone online will be disconnected while the world comes back up.
admin.action.save_confirm: Write the world to disk now. Players may hitch for a moment.
admin.action.stop_confirm: The world will save and the container will stop. Nobody can join until you start it again.
admin.action.suspend_confirm: They will be kicked and cannot rejoin for :duration, until :until.
admin.action.unban_confirm: They will be able to join again.
admin.bridge_description: What the game mod is writing into the shared Lua folder. Some files only appear after the first death or the first /account register. Live positions and stats follow the in-game clock, so they go quiet on an empty paused server.
admin.bridge_missing: The mod has not written this yet.
admin.bridge_reason_event_ready: Written when the event happens. An old stamp just means nothing new has happened.
admin.bridge_reason_event_waiting: Created on the first death or the first /account register. Missing until then is normal.
admin.bridge_reason_heartbeat_absent: The world clock is running but this export has never been written.
admin.bridge_reason_heartbeat_stale: The world clock is running and this file has stopped rewriting.
admin.bridge_reason_live: Rewritten while someone is in the world.
admin.bridge_reason_paused: The world is paused with nobody online. These files update again when a player joins.
admin.bridge_reason_world_absent: The mod has not written world state. It should appear as soon as the dedicated server finishes loading.
admin.bridge_reason_world_live: Rewritten every few seconds, even while the server is empty.
admin.bridge_reason_world_stale: World state has stopped rewriting. The mod is not ticking.
admin.bridge_world_paused: The dedicated server is paused because nobody is connected. Live positions and stats will sit still until someone joins.
admin.config_description: The live server.ini, grouped the way you look for things. A change is on disk immediately; the game reads it on the next restart.
admin.config_help_AdminPassword: Used for /setaccesslevel style admin login in-game.
admin.config_help_AllowCoop: Let more than one local player join from the same client.
admin.config_help_AllowDestructionBySled: Players can demolish tiles with a sledgehammer.
admin.config_help_AllowNonAsciiUsername: Permit characters outside A–Z in usernames.
admin.config_help_AnnounceAnimalDeath: Broadcast when a tracked animal dies.
admin.config_help_AntiCheatChecksum: Action level 0–4 for file checksum failures.
admin.config_help_AntiCheatHit: Action level 0–4 for impossible hit reports.
admin.config_help_AntiCheatNoClip: Action level 0–4 for walking through walls.
admin.config_help_AntiCheatPlayer: Action level 0–4 for impossible player stats.
admin.config_help_AntiCheatSpeed: Action level 0–4 for movement speed hacks.
admin.config_help_AntiCheatXP: Action level 0–4 for impossible skill gains.
admin.config_help_AutoCreateUserInWhiteL: Store credentials when a player first joins. Needed for website login sync.
admin.config_help_BackupsCount: How many rolling backups the dedicated server keeps.
admin.config_help_BackupsOnStart: Take a copy when the dedicated server boots.
admin.config_help_BackupsOnVersionChange: Take a copy when the game version changes.
admin.config_help_BackupsPeriod: Minutes between periodic backups. 0 disables the timer.
admin.config_help_BadWordListFile: Path to the word list, relative to the server folder.
admin.config_help_BadWordPolicy: What to do on a match. The game uses a small integer enum.
admin.config_help_BadWordReplacement: Text that replaces a matched word when the policy is replace.
admin.config_help_BanKickGlobalSound: Play the global sting when someone is kicked or banned.
admin.config_help_CarEngineAttractionMod: How far a running engine pulls zombies. 1 is default.
admin.config_help_ChatMessageCharacterLi: Maximum length of one chat line.
admin.config_help_ChatMessageSlowModeTim: Seconds a player must wait between lines. 0 is off.
admin.config_help_ChatStreams: Enabled channels, comma-separated (s, r, a, w, y, sh, f, all).
admin.config_help_ClientActionLogs: Which client actions are written to the log.
admin.config_help_ClientCommandFilter: Commands the server will ignore from clients.
admin.config_help_DayLength: How long a day lasts. Many builds keep this in SandboxVars instead.
admin.config_help_DefaultPort: Primary Steam/UDP port. Docker already publishes 16261 — changing this needs a matching compose change.
admin.config_help_DenyLoginOnOverloadedS: Turn people away instead of letting the tick rate collapse.
admin.config_help_DisableRadioAdmin: Admin voices stay off the radio.
admin.config_help_DisableRadioGM: Game-master voices stay off the radio.
admin.config_help_DisableRadioModerator: Moderator voices stay off the radio.
admin.config_help_DisableRadioOverseer: Overseer voices stay off the radio.
admin.config_help_DisableRadioStaff: Staff voices do not go out over in-game radios.
admin.config_help_DisableSafehouseWhenOw: The safehouse rules turn off while the owner is in the world.
admin.config_help_DiscordCommandChannel: Channel id that may send RCON-style commands.
admin.config_help_DiscordEnable: Relay chat to a Discord bot.
admin.config_help_DiscordToken: Bot token. Leave blank when editing to keep the current value.
admin.config_help_DoLuaChecksum: Kick clients whose Lua files do not match the server.
admin.config_help_DropOffWhiteListAfterD: Remove the name from the whitelist when they die.
admin.config_help_Faction: Players can found a faction and a tag.
admin.config_help_FactionDaySurvivedToCr: Survival days required to create a faction.
admin.config_help_FactionPlayersRequired: How many people before the faction name shows.
admin.config_help_FastForwardMultiplier: How hard the clock runs while everyone is asleep.
admin.config_help_GoodWordListFile: Exceptions that should not be filtered.
admin.config_help_HideAdminsInPlayerList: Staff names stay off the in-game player list.
admin.config_help_HideDisguisedUserName: Do not reveal the real account while a disguise is on.
admin.config_help_HidePlayersBehindYou: Do not draw players outside the camera cone.
admin.config_help_ItemNumbersLimitPerCon: 0 means no extra cap beyond weight.
admin.config_help_KnockedDownAllowed: Combat can knock a player to the ground.
admin.config_help_LoginQueueConnectTimeo: Seconds a queued client has to finish connecting.
admin.config_help_LoginQueueEnabled: Hold extra joiners in a queue when the server is full.
admin.config_help_Map: Semicolon-separated map folders. Workshop maps are also added from the mods page.
admin.config_help_MapRemotePlayerVisibil: Who can see other survivors as map markers.
admin.config_help_MaxPacketsPerSecond: Drop a client that sends faster than this.
admin.config_help_MaxPlayers: Hard cap on who can be in the world at once.
admin.config_help_MaxSafezoneSize: Area cap for a single safehouse, in tiles.
admin.config_help_Mods: Load-order mod ids. Edit them on the mods page so WorkshopItems stays in sync.
admin.config_help_MouseOverToSeeDisplayN: Only show a name when the cursor is over them.
admin.config_help_MultiplayerStatisticsP: How often to write multiplayer stats, in minutes.
admin.config_help_NightLength: How long night lasts, in in-game hours if the build exposes it here.
admin.config_help_Open: When off, only names already on the whitelist can join.
admin.config_help_Password: Required to connect. Leave empty when editing to keep the current password.
admin.config_help_PauseEmpty: Freezes the world clock when nobody is connected.
admin.config_help_PerkLogs: Write skill changes to the log.
admin.config_help_PingLimit: Kick players above this ping. 0 disables the check.
admin.config_help_PlayerBumpPlayer: Walking into another player pushes them.
admin.config_help_PlayerRespawnWithOther: A dead player can come back at another player.
admin.config_help_PlayerRespawnWithSelf: A dead player can come back at their body.
admin.config_help_Public: Show this server in the public browser.
admin.config_help_PublicDescription: Short blurb under the name in the server browser.
admin.config_help_PublicName: Shown in the public server browser.
admin.config_help_PVPFirearmDamageModifi: Percentage of normal gun damage against players.
admin.config_help_PVPLogToolChat: Print PVP hits into staff chat.
admin.config_help_PVPLogToolFile: Write PVP hits into the server log.
admin.config_help_PVPMeleeDamageModifier: Percentage of normal melee damage against players.
admin.config_help_RCONPassword: Set in the environment, not from this page.
admin.config_help_RCONPort: Internal only. This panel talks to it; do not expose it publicly.
admin.config_help_RemovePlayerCorpsesOnC: Server corpse cleanup also deletes player bodies.
admin.config_help_ResetID: Raising this forces clients to treat the world as new. It is a wipe signal, not a backup.
admin.config_help_SafehouseAllowLoot: Non-members can take items from a claimed house.
admin.config_help_SafehouseAllowNonResid: Warehouses and shops can be claimed too.
admin.config_help_SafehouseAllowRespawn: Members can come back inside their claim.
admin.config_help_SafehouseAllowTrepass: Non-members can walk into a claimed house.
admin.config_help_SafehouseDaySurvivedTo: How long a character must survive before they can claim.
admin.config_help_SafehouseDisableDisgui: Disguises are stripped inside a claim.
admin.config_help_SafehousePreventsLootR: Containers inside a claim do not refill.
admin.config_help_SafeHouseRemovalTime: A safehouse with nobody home is released after this many hours.
admin.config_help_SafetyCooldownTimer: Seconds before safety can be toggled again.
admin.config_help_SafetyDisconnectDelay: Seconds a player stays vulnerable after they leave.
admin.config_help_SafetySystem: Players can toggle a safety flag before they can be hurt.
admin.config_help_SafetyToggleTimer: Seconds before a safety change takes effect.
admin.config_help_SaveWorldEveryMinutes: Minutes between automatic world saves. 0 turns autosave off.
admin.config_help_Seed: Randomisation seed. Changing it after the world exists does nothing useful.
admin.config_help_server_browser_announc: IP advertised to the browser. Leave blank to use the detected address.
admin.config_help_ServerName: Folder name for this world. Changing it points the server at a different save.
admin.config_help_ServerPlayerID: Identity stamp for this world. Changing it orphans existing characters.
admin.config_help_ServerWelcomeMessage: Shown in chat when someone joins. Enter inserts <LINE>. Colour with <RGB:1,0,0> (values 0–1).
admin.config_help_ShowCoordinates: Players can see their map coordinates.
admin.config_help_ShowFirstAndLastName: Use the survivor first and last name instead of the account.
admin.config_help_ShowSafety: Draw the safety skull over other players.
admin.config_help_SledgehammerOnlyInSafe: Demolition only works inside a claimed safehouse.
admin.config_help_SleepAllowed: Players can lie down and sleep.
admin.config_help_SneakModeHideFromOther: Crouching hides you from other survivors, not just zombies.
admin.config_help_SpawnItems: Item full types given on first spawn, separated by semicolons.
admin.config_help_SpawnPoint: x,y,z or empty for the map default.
admin.config_help_SpeedLimit: Anti-speedhack ceiling. Too low will rubber-band legitimate players.
admin.config_help_SteamScoreboard: Show Steam names on the scoreboard.
admin.config_help_SwitchZombiesOwnership: Hand zombies to the nearest player every tick. Costs CPU.
admin.config_help_TrashDeleteAll: A trash container can destroy its whole contents at once.
admin.config_help_UDPPort: Second game port. Docker already publishes 16262.
admin.config_help_UltraSpeedDoesnotAffec: Animal simulation stays at normal speed while sleeping.
admin.config_help_UPnP: Ask the router to forward ports. Usually off behind Docker.
admin.config_help_UsePhysicsHitReaction: Hits use the physics flinch instead of the old animation.
admin.config_help_UsernameDisguises: Players can hide their account name behind a disguise.
admin.config_help_Voice3D: Pan voice by direction, not only distance.
admin.config_help_VoiceMinDistance: Range where voice is still full volume.
admin.config_help_War: Factions can declare war on each other.
admin.config_help_WarDuration: How long a war lasts, in seconds.
admin.config_help_WarSafehouseHitPoints: Hits a claim can take during a war before it falls.
admin.config_help_WarStartDelay: Seconds between a declaration and the fighting.
admin.config_help_WorkshopItems: Steam file ids. Edit them on the mods page.
admin.config_missing: The server has not written its config yet. Start it once and this fills in.
admin.config_restart_hint: Most of these need a restart before the game notices.
admin.config_search_hint: Letters in order across the name, the INI key or the description. Slash focuses the box. Escape clears it.
admin.config_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current value.
admin.config_set_DisableSafehouseWhenOwn: Disable claim while owner is online
admin.console_description: Talks to the dedicated server over RCON. Arrow keys walk the commands you have already sent.
admin.console_empty: Nothing sent yet. Try players, or save.
admin.console_hint: Useful: players, save, servermsg, kickuser, banuser, setaccesslevel, additem.
admin.controls_hint: Start, stop and restart the container. Save writes the world without taking it down.
admin.logs_description: The game container's own output — the same stream as docker logs. This is what SteamCMD and the dedicated server print while they start.
admin.logs_empty: The container has not printed anything yet.
admin.logs_no_matches: Nothing in this tail matches that.
admin.logs_search_hint: Letters in order, not a whole phrase. Slash focuses the box. Escape clears it.
admin.map_counts: :total survivors · :online in game · :offline last known · :dead dead
admin.map_description: Everyone the mod has a position for. Amber is the selected survivor, moss is online, dust is last known, blood is dead. Click a pin or a name to centre. Pick a destination on the map, then teleport — not back to where they already stand.
admin.map_no_matches: Nobody on the map matches that.
admin.map_offline_teleport: They are not in the world. Teleport only works while they are online.
admin.map_pick_hint: Click the map, or right-click, to drop a destination. Then teleport.
admin.moderation_broadcast_confirm: Everyone online will see this in chat.
admin.moderation_description: Deaths and player kills, where they happened, and who you lock out. A suspension is a timed ban — they cannot join until it lifts.
admin.moderation_message_hint: Shown in-game to everyone online. Quotes are stripped.
admin.moderation_name_hint: From a row, an online chip, or typed from chat.
admin.moderation_no_events: No deaths or PvP kills match those filters yet.
admin.moderation_none_held: Nobody is suspended or banned from this panel.
admin.moderation_reason_hint: Shown on the kick. Optional. Stored with the suspension.
admin.moderation_search_placeholder: Find a name, weapon or cause
admin.moderation_suspended: Suspended. They cannot join until it lifts.
admin.reports_empty: Nothing matches that. Players file reports from their own page.
admin.reports_pick: Select a report to read it and reply.
admin.reports_reply_hint: Sent to the player in game and on their reports page.
admin.reports_search_placeholder: Find a subject, name or reply
admin.mods_added: Added. Restart the server before it loads.
admin.mods_description: WorkshopItems and Mods stay paired. Removing Knox Relay is refused — this panel reads it.
admin.mods_empty: No mods listed in server.ini yet.
admin.mods_import_hint: WorkshopItems= and Mods= lines, or Workshop ids separated by spaces, commas or newlines.
admin.mods_imported: Imported. Restart before the game loads them.
admin.mods_lookup_missing: Steam has no file with that id. You can still type the mod id yourself.
admin.mods_lookup_no_ids: No Mod ID: line in the description. Type it below.
admin.mods_map_hint: Added to Map= if the Workshop file ships a cell.
admin.mods_removed: Removed. Restart before the game drops it.
admin.mods_reorder_disabled: Clear the filter to change load order.
admin.mods_reordered: Load order saved. Restart before the game follows it.
admin.mods_restart_hint: The game only rereads this list on boot.
admin.mods_restart_offline: The container is not running. Start it from the overview if you meant to boot it.
admin.mods_suggested: Mod ids from the Workshop description
admin.mods_workshop_hint: Digits, or a steamcommunity.com sharedfiles URL.
admin.overview_description: What the server is doing right now, and what the world has been through.
admin.players_hint: Kick and ban go through RCON. They only work while the dedicated server is answering.
admin.site_connect_hint: Leave empty to hide the connect panel on the public site.
admin.site_description: The English copy the public site is built from. A German override is a separate translation, not a second site.
admin.under_construction: Shop, backups, news and the rest of the old panel still live there. Sidebar entries marked "soon" have not been ported.
admin.whitelist_description: Open means anyone can create a character. Closed means only names you add here get in.
admin.whitelist_names_hint: The game keeps the list. This page cannot show who is already on it.
admin.whitelist_open_off: The server is closed. Only whitelisted names can join.
admin.whitelist_open_on: The server is open. Anyone can join and create a character.
admin.whitelist_saved: Join policy updated. Restart for the game to notice.
auth.login_description: Your account follows your character. Same name, same survivor.
auth.password_too_short: Password must be at least :min characters.
auth.register_description: Accounts start in game. Run the command on the server, then finish here.
auth.step_code: The server replies with a six-character code. Enter it below.
auth.step_join: Join the server and play as the character you want the account for.
auth.username_hint: The name you play under, not your email.
body.head: Head
character.description: Read from the server's own export, refreshed while you play.
character.never_played_body: Nothing has been recorded for :username yet. Join the server with that exact name — your vitals appear within seconds, and kills and hours follow on the server's next export.
character.title: Your character
features.subtitle: What you are signing up for, in plain terms.
features.title: What you get
inventory.description: A snapshot the server took while you were playing, not a live feed.
inventory.empty_body: The server writes a snapshot while you play. Join the server and this fills in on its own.
inventory.refresh_offline: Only possible while you are in game.
inventory.refresh_queued: Asked the server for a fresh one — it lands in a moment.
inventory.title: What you are carrying
map.attribution: Schematic basemap built from the server's own map data.
map.attribution_iso: Isometric tiles from map.projectzomboid.com. Pins are live from this server.
map.canvas_label: Map of Knox County. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
map.click_hint: Click the map to read a coordinate.
me.reports_description: Reports you filed and replies from the team. The same tickets open in the Knox Desk in game.
me.reports_empty: You have not filed a report yet.
me.reports_pick: Select a ticket to read the thread.
map.description: The mod reports every survivor's position every thirty seconds.
map.load_failed: The map could not be loaded.
map.no_position: The server has not reported a position for you yet. Join the server and it fills in on its own.
map.title: Where you are
me.description: Your survivor, your holdings and the state of the server.
moodle.title: Needs
not_found.body: That page does not exist, or it moved while you were away.
not_found.title: Nothing here
obituary.description: The server log records that somebody died. Only the game knows why.
obituary.empty_body: Give it time. The moment somebody does, the server records what took them and it lands on this page.
obituary.load_failed: Could not reach further back. Try again.
obituary.title: The dead
rankings.subtitle: Every survivor the server has reported on, sorted however you like.
rankings.title: Rankings
stats.title: Body count
status.address_hidden: Ask an admin for the address
status.offline_note: The server is down right now. Stats below are from the last time it was up.
status.roster_offline: The server is offline, so there is nobody to list
status.starting_note: The world is still loading. Give it a minute.
status.subtitle: Read straight off the server, refreshed every few seconds.
status.title: Live from Knox County
survivors.subtitle: Ranked by confirmed kills. Dying does not reset the board.
survivors.title: Top survivors
